verdict.rationale: A system-to-system filing channel is a fair question for a state corporate registry, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only human-facing paths: PDF forms submitted by upload, fax or mail, and a keyless franchise-tax portal behind an image CAPTCHA. OpenAPI probes all return 404, and no system-account, transmitter or batch-provider program or enrollment path is documented. Registered agents acting as a de facto service layer is an observation, not a published machine channel, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
